'''Broken CDs''' are a type of [[trash]] that can be caught when fishing during all seasons, in any location, using either a [[Tools#Fishing Poles|Fishing Pole]] or a [[Crab Pot]].  They can also be found in [[Garbage Can]]s, and any crab pot fish may produce a Broken CD when placed in a [[Fish Pond]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

Broken CDs can be [[Recycling Machine|recycled]] into [[Refined Quartz]].

==Bundles==
Broken CD is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Broken CD is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Broken CD is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt232|link=Tailoring{{!}}Trash Can Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a cyan dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the blue dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
During the special order quest [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Community Cleanup]] the player is tasked with gathering 20 trash items (except Joja Cola).
